channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Banks & NBFCs in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.4).

item.title: [+1] Nifty gains 0.46% on the week to 25,144, a third straight weekly rise; smallcaps add 3.15%
item.description:
Bank stocks outperformed with a 3.7% weekly gain; the midcap index rose 1.56%. Friday's 0.61% fall trimmed the advance. Analysts see support at 24,800 and resistance at 25,400–25,500. Rally slowing after last week's 8.6% jump.

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Banks led the week

Why it matters: Momentum is fading as inflation and oil return as worries; broader-market strength shows domestic risk appetite is intact but the index needs fresh inflows to clear resistance.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Foreign investors buy about ₹33,340 crore of Indian shares in the week, extending November inflows
item.description:
Exchange-based weekly tallies vary by source, but all show heavy buying for a second week after October's ₹34,843 crore outflow. Analysts warn that slower inflows with continued domestic fund selling could raise volatility. Ongoing.

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Largest foreign-owned sector

Why it matters: Foreign buying has driven the rally and supported the rupee; its persistence despite higher US yields is the main cushion for equities.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows +2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
